question: Can two direction-conditioned scalar carrier prototypes replace both confirmation-row donor activations and v10's per-row target-guided grid search on fresh constructions?

novelty_search.result: V10 is donor-free but selects alpha separately from each base state and requested target/foil readout. No aspectual test freezes one alpha per semantic direction before fresh evaluation.

frozen_design.calibration: From the immutable scalar result's 16 lexical selection records, group exact full-program carrier amplitudes by direction_id and take the arithmetic mean.
frozen_design.confirmation: All 64 fresh A1/A2/P/C rows. A-family and P interventions add alpha_direction*q; C receives the same alternating direction prototype as its group parity. No confirmation activation, margin, target ID, foil ID, or outcome enters alpha.

predictions.pred_a_authority_calibration_capability_: All hashes, audited calibration recomputation, basis, native capability, and exact-head replay pass.
predictions.pred_b_fixed_target_independent_actuator: Exactly two finite frozen scalars are used and no confirmation state/readout/outcome changes alpha.
predictions.pred_c_fresh_A_prediction: Fresh A1/A2 each reach at least 0.50 native-donor recovery, 0.75 direction, and 0.50 of v10's mean recovery.
predictions.pred_d_fresh_P_generalization: Fresh noun-shifted starts reach at least 0.50 mean requested margin reflection and 0.75 direction.
predictions.pred_e_fresh_C_selectivity: Fresh C moves by at most 0.20 of the frozen A target scale.
predictions.pred_f_exact_coverage_and_price: All 64 confirmation rows are unique within 25 counted forwards, 200 example evaluations, 64 selected-head evaluations, zero grid search/backward/update, and two fitted scalars plus the existing basis.

terminal.screen: A-F pass: a two-scalar semantic-direction program predicts selective carrier actuation on fresh constructions without donor states or target-guided optimization.
terminal.null: Authority and coverage pass but fixed direction prototypes fail A/P prediction or C selectivity.
terminal.invalid: Authority, audited calibration, basis, native capability, exact-head control, fixed-actuator identity, or coverage fails.
